name: upgrade_planner
description:
Ranked standalone upgrade recommendations for project dependencies — call before upgrading, adding, or auditing any dependency to pick the safest order. Combines vulnerability severity, deprecation status, and version distance into a prioritized plan.

Splits recommendations three ways: quick wins (safe patch/minor upgrades), breaking changes (major version bumps), and transitive CVEs marked waiting_on_upstream (not declared in your manifest — the fix arrives via a parent package update or a lockfile refresh). Call dependency_health first for registry context and vulnerability_scan first for a CVE-aware plan; without a scan the output says it is CVE-blind.

Provenance: standalone heuristic — a point-in-time plan from local lockfiles plus live registry/OSV lookups, not the 4DA desktop app's cross-project, version-confirmed plan.

Privacy: live mode may query public registries and OSV with package names and versions. It never sends source code.

risk_threshold.description: Only show upgrades at or above this risk level. Default: all.
